title: Palmly compatibility narrative (v1)
description: Both-perspectives compatibility narrative (Backend §7.3). The score + sub_scores are DETERMINISTIC (compat.v1 scorer) and passed in as ground truth; the model only writes the prose — a headline, a one-line score framing, and three sections (strengths / frictions / advice). Structured so the client renders native cards. `key`/`tags` are code-set; headline/score_line/body are model prose.
